A. NEIGHBORHOOD TRAFFIC MANAGEMENT PROGRAM � TOOLBOX, PETITION, AND FLOWCHART
SUMMARY
Over the last several months, the Traffic Commission has worked on the development of the Neighborhood Traffic Management Program (NTMP) including a traffic calming toolbox, criteria for the installation of traffic calming measures, and a flowchart/step-by-step guide that would be used to assist residents with the process. As proposed, the process for initiating a review of traffic conditions would involve greater resident input and participation. This ensures that traffic issues are driven by a neighborhood and not just one or two individuals.
Each of the NTMP components � toolbox, petition, and flowchart � has been reviewed by the Commission. A final draft of the entire NTMP document is included with this report. Following the approval of the entire NTMP by the Commission, we will work to schedule outreach workshops with members of the public and public safety officials. Following this outreach process, we will review the final draft document and public comments with the City Council.
Staff Recommendation
It is recommended that the Traffic Commission approve the revised Neighborhood Traffic Management Program (NTMP) document.
